issue.title: Percentage should interpret percent units

issue.title: Clamp must support lower and upper bounds
issue.body: clamp should return lower when value is below lower and upper when value is above upper, while preserving values inside the interval.

verification_commands: python3 -c 'from forgecalc.calculator import clamp; assert clamp(-3, 0, 10) == 0; assert clamp(4, 0, 10) == 4; assert clamp(12, 0, 10) == 10'

runs.patch:
diff --git a/forgecalc/calculator.py b/forgecalc/calculator.py
index 644c671..bd64996 100644
--- a/forgecalc/calculator.py
+++ b/forgecalc/calculator.py
@@ -5,7 +5,7 @@ def percentage(value: float, percent: float) -> float:
 
 def clamp(value: float, lower: float, upper: float) -> float:
     """Keep value inside the inclusive interval."""
-    return min(lower, max(value, upper))
+    return max(lower, min(value, upper))
 
 
 def mean(values: list[float]) -> float:
